response.subject: This week at Yale: sweet treats, game night, dinner
response.intro: Here are the events worth your week, with free food and open-to-all picks up top.

picks.line: Free sweet treats from the Silliman GA, but you need to be Silliman.
Hot Murga and a talk on culture, consent, and care.
Free family-style dinner at AACC before November Recess.
Casual game night at AACC, no sign-up needed.
The Veritas Search weighs Handsome Dan at Beinecke Plaza, a classic Tuesday night tradition.
Quick wellness check-ins at the GLC booth in YSC, ten minutes each.
Mechanical engineering seminar with Jacob Notbohm in Rosenfeld 101.
